title: Finite-lisse relative coefficient dual
statement: Let Lambda be a finite commutative ring which is a field, X a scheme, L a finite locally constant Lambda-module sheaf, and W an invertible bounded constructible finite-Tor complex. Put K=L[0] and N=RHom(K,W). Then N is dualizable and bounded constructible of finite Tor dimension, and the canonical W-bidual map K -> RHom(N,W) is an isomorphism. The notation is that of [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant] [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories].

source.place: First two paragraphs: finite local system, invertible relative dualizing coefficient, and relative biduality.

proof.text: Use flat_of_isField and the explicit exact pairing of the finite local system with its sheaf dual. The bounded degree-zero complex is termwise dualizable, so isDualizable_Q_obj and singleFunctorIsoCompQ show that K=L[0] is dualizable. The categorical invertible-dualizing lemmas give dualizability of RHom(K,W) and invertibility of the canonical W-bidual map. The coefficient dual of K is the degree-zero sheaf dual by dual_singleFunctor, hence bounded constructible of Tor amplitude [0,0]. The explicit isomorphism RHom(K,W) ≅ coefficientDual(K) tensor W and constructibleFiniteTor_tensor give bounded constructibility and finite Tor amplitude. The relative dual is an explicit internal Hom and the bidual map is the usual braided evaluation transpose followed by the equality isomorphism of this alias.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteLisseRelativeDual
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ] (hfield : IsField Λ) (X : Scheme.{u})
    (L : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hL : IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf L)
    (W : DerivedCategoryModule Λ X)
    (hW : DerivedCategory.isInvertible Λ X W)
    (hWc : DerivedCategory.boundedConstructibleFiniteTor
      Λ X W) :
    let K := (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj L
    let N := smoothRelativeDual (ModuleCat Λ) X K W
    smoothRelativeDualizable (ModuleCat Λ) X N ∧
      DerivedCategory.boundedConstructibleFiniteTor Λ X N ∧
      IsIso (smoothRelativeBidualMap
        (ModuleCat Λ) X W K)
